# ScienceAlert
> Independent, fact-checked science journalism covering health, space, nature, technology, physics, humans, and the environment.

ScienceAlert publishes accessible reporting on new research, scientific discoveries, and evidence-based explainers. The site is organized around major science beats and also includes opinion, feature, and editorial information for readers seeking context beyond daily news.

## Main Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.sciencealert.com): Front page featuring the latest science news, discoveries, and editor-selected stories.
- [Space](https://www.sciencealert.com/space): Astronomy and spaceflight coverage including planets, stars, black holes, and missions.
- [Health](https://www.sciencealert.com/health): Medical and public health reporting on disease, nutrition, aging, and neuroscience.
- [Environment](https://www.sciencealert.com/environment): Climate, ecosystems, weather, oceans, and environmental change news and analysis.
- [Humans](https://www.sciencealert.com/humans): Human biology, evolution, archaeology, psychology, and anthropology coverage.
- [Tech](https://www.sciencealert.com/tech): Technology reporting on AI, computing, engineering, and emerging scientific tools.
- [Nature](https://www.sciencealert.com/nature): Wildlife, paleontology, biodiversity, animal behavior, and natural world discoveries.
- [Physics](https://www.sciencealert.com/physics): Physics news spanning quantum science, cosmology, particles, and fundamental laws.

## Editorial Formats
- [Explainer](https://www.sciencealert.com/explainer): Background pieces that clarify scientific concepts, mechanisms, and ongoing debates.
- [Opinion](https://www.sciencealert.com/opinion): Commentary and perspective articles on science, ethics, and policy questions.
- [Features](https://www.sciencealert.com/features): Longer-form stories and in-depth reporting on major scientific topics.
- [Society](https://www.sciencealert.com/society): Coverage of science in culture, misinformation, policy, and social impact.
- [Good News](https://www.sciencealert.com/good-news): Positive science and conservation stories highlighting progress and recovery.
- [Podcasts](https://www.sciencealert.com/podcasts): Audio content and podcast-related science storytelling and interviews.

## Space Coverage
- [Astronomy](https://www.sciencealert.com/space): Broad astronomy reporting on telescopes, galaxies, exoplanets, and cosmic events.
- [Mars](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/mars): Stories about Mars missions, geology, atmosphere, and habitability research.
- [NASA](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/nasa): Coverage of NASA missions, discoveries, spacecraft, and agency announcements.
- [Black Holes](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/black-holes): Research and observations related to black holes and extreme astrophysics.
- [James Webb Space Telescope](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/james-webb-space-telescope): News and findings from JWST observations and analysis.
- [Exoplanets](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/exoplanets): Discoveries and studies of planets orbiting stars beyond the Solar System.

## Health Coverage
- [Health News](https://www.sciencealert.com/health): Main health desk for medicine, disease, sleep, diet, and brain science.
- [COVID](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/covid): Reporting on SARS-CoV-2 research, variants, vaccines, and long-term effects.
- [Cancer](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/cancer): Cancer biology, treatment advances, screening, and epidemiology coverage.
- [Alzheimer's](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/alzheimers): Research on dementia, neurodegeneration, risk factors, and treatments.
- [Sleep](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/sleep): Studies on sleep quality, circadian rhythms, and health outcomes.
- [Nutrition](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/nutrition): Evidence-based reporting on diet, metabolism, and nutritional science.

## Environment & Nature
- [Climate Change](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/climate-change): Reporting on warming trends, impacts, mitigation, and climate science.
- [Oceans](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/oceans): Marine ecosystems, ocean warming, currents, and sea life discoveries.
- [Wildlife](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/wildlife): Animal populations, conservation, and field biology stories.
- [Dinosaurs](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/dinosaurs): Paleontology news on dinosaur fossils, evolution, and ancient ecosystems.
- [Conservation](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/conservation): Coverage of biodiversity protection, restoration, and species recovery efforts.
- [Weather](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/weather): Extreme weather, atmospheric science, and forecasting-related reporting.

## Humans, Mind & Society
- [Archaeology](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/archaeology): Discoveries about ancient cultures, artifacts, and human history.
- [Evolution](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/evolution): Research on human origins, adaptation, and evolutionary biology.
- [Psychology](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/psychology): Studies of behavior, cognition, mental health, and decision-making.
- [Brain](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/brain): Neuroscience reporting on cognition, disease, perception, and brain function.
- [Genetics](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/genetics): Human and biological genetics, inheritance, and genomic research coverage.
- [Society](https://www.sciencealert.com/society): Science-related social issues, public understanding, and evidence in civic life.

## Technology & Physics
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/artificial-intelligence): AI research, applications, risks, and machine learning developments.
- [Quantum Computing](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/quantum-computing): Advances in quantum hardware, algorithms, and computing theory.
- [Robotics](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/robotics): Robotics engineering, autonomous systems, and scientific applications.
- [Quantum Physics](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/quantum-physics): Quantum mechanics research, experiments, and theoretical developments.
- [CERN](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/cern): Particle physics news tied to CERN experiments and collider findings.
- [Dark Matter](https://www.sciencealert.com/tag/dark-matter): Studies investigating dark matter evidence, models, and detection efforts.
